decisions.what: Skipped task 001 (.gitignore) — left the existing pre-existing infra .gitignore file untouched
decisions.why: Session instructions explicitly said to ignore changes to .gitignore and other setup/infra files (do not modify, revert, or discuss).

decisions.what: Used @typescript-eslint/parser + @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin (v7) directly instead of the newer typescript-eslint umbrella package
decisions.why: The package.json specification explicitly names @typescript-eslint/parser and @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin as required devDependencies.

decisions.what: Used PixiJS 8.x async init pattern (new Application(); await app.init({...}); document.body.appendChild(app.canvas))
decisions.why: PixiJS 8 changed Application construction to require async init; the spec references PixiJS 8.x and instructs to use async/await if needed.

decisions.what: Added an inline eslint-disable-next-line no-console before the console.log in src/main.ts
decisions.why: The spec requires a console.log confirmation, but eslint.config.js sets no-console to warn — the disable keeps the intentional init log clean under lint.
